subject: general
question: Which edition of the Indian Premier League was held in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18th edition.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The 2025 Indian Premier League was the 18th edition of the IPL, branded as TATA IPL 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Annual Tournament:** IPL has been held every year since 2008, making 2025 the 18th edition.
 
• **Number of Teams:** The 18th edition featured 10 teams competing in 74 matches.
 
• **Season Challenges:** The season was suspended due to the India–Pakistan crisis and resumed after a brief break.
 
• **Defending Champions:** Kolkata Knight Riders entered as defending champions but were eliminated in the league stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **IPL History:** The Indian Premier League started in 2008 and has grown into one of the world’s premier T20 cricket leagues.
 
• **Franchise Teams:** The league operates on a franchise model with teams representing various Indian cities.
 
• **IPL Brand:** The 2025 season was branded as TATA IPL 2025 due to sponsorship.
 
• **Suspension & Resumption:** The 18th edition faced interruptions due to geopolitical tensions but successfully concluded in June 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The IPL 2025 season came to an end with Royal Challengers Bengaluru triumphing over Punjab Kings in a memorable final, with Krunal Pandya winning his second Final player of the match award for a special display of defensive spin bowling to finish with figures of 2-17.
 
• Winner: Royal Challengers Bengaluru
 
• Runner Up: Punjab Kings
 
• Most Valuable Player: Suryakumar Yadav (MI) – 717 runs, avg 65, SR 168
 
• Purple Cap: Prasidh Krishna (GT) – 25 wickets
 
• Emerging Player: Sai Sudharsan (GT) – 759 runs
 
• Super Striker: Vaibhav Suryavanshi (RR) – 206.6 SR
 
• Most Sixes: Nicholas Pooran (LSG) – 40 sixes
 
• Most Fours: Sai Sudharsan (GT) – 88 fours
 
• Most Dot Balls: Mohammed Siraj (GT) – 151 dot balls
 
• Catch of the Season: Kamindu Mendis (SRH) vs Dewald Brevis
 
• Fairplay Award: Chennai Super Kings
 
• Fantasy King: Sai Sudharsan (GT) – 1495 points
